title: What is HackBattle?
text: HackBattle is a 36-hour hackathon organized as part of ARCS by IEEE-CS VIT.

title: Who organizes HackBattle?
text: HackBattle is organized by IEEE-CS VIT under its flagship event ARCS.

title: When is HackBattle usually held?
text: HackBattle is typically conducted during ARCS in September.

title: Where is HackBattle conducted?
text: HackBattle takes place at VIT Vellore, usually in Anna Auditorium.

title: What is the duration of HackBattle?
text: HackBattle is a continuous 36-hour hackathon.

title: What are the tracks in HackBattle?
text: HackBattle includes tracks like Healthcare, Fintech, IoT, Game Development, and SDG-focused themes.

title: Can freshers participate in HackBattle?
text: Yes, HackBattle is fresher-friendly and welcomes participants from all years.

title: What is the team size for HackBattle?
text: Teams can have between 3 to 6 members.

title: Can I participate in HackBattle without a team?
text: Yes, individuals without teams will be grouped with others before the event.

title: What is Cicada 3310?
text: Cicada 3310 is a technical hunt event held alongside HackBattle as part of ARCS.

title: When was Cicada 3310 held in ARCS’24?
text: Cicada 3310 took place on 22 September at TT Voc.

title: What was the registration fee for HackBattle?
text: HackBattle had a registration fee of ₹250.

title: What was the registration fee for Cicada 3310?
text: Cicada 3310 had a registration fee of ₹200.

title: Are HackBattle participants provided OD?
text: Yes, participants receive OD, and IDs are scanned periodically.

title: What should I bring for HackBattle?
text: Participants should bring their laptop, charger, water bottle, power bank, extension cord, and VIT ID card.

title: Are breaks provided during HackBattle?
text: Yes, scheduled breaks are given for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

title: Will refreshments be available at HackBattle?
text: Yes, food and beverages are provided throughout the event.

title: Are sessions conducted during HackBattle?
text: Yes, expert talks and engaging activities are included.

title: Who was the guest speaker at HackBattle?
text: Mr. Savinder Puri was featured as an industry expert speaker.

title: What are the judging criteria at HackBattle?
text: Projects are judged on innovation, implementation, impact, and presentation.

title: Who are the mentors at HackBattle?
text: Experienced mentors guide participants throughout the hackathon.

title: Are cross-year teams allowed in HackBattle?
text: Yes, participants from different years and departments can team up.

title: Do I need to submit code for HackBattle?
text: Yes, submissions must include source code, documentation, and a demo.

title: Can I use an existing project in HackBattle?
text: No, projects must be developed from scratch during the event.

title: Are prizes given to HackBattle winners?
text: Yes, winners receive cash prizes, goodies, and recognition.

title: Is HackBattle open to all colleges?
text: HackBattle is primarily for VIT students, though some events may allow external participation.

title: What skills are required for HackBattle?
text: Programming, problem-solving, teamwork, and creativity are key skills.

title: Can non-coders participate in HackBattle?
text: Yes, design, management, and idea pitching skills are equally valued.

title: How can I register for HackBattle?
text: Registration is done through the official Gravitas website.

title: How can I register for Cicada?
text: Cicada registration is also via the Gravitas portal.

title: What is ARCS?
text: ARCS is the annual flagship event of IEEE-CS VIT, featuring HackBattle and Cicada.

title: Why should I participate in HackBattle?
text: HackBattle offers problem-solving, networking, learning, and innovation opportunities.

title: What is Hack4Impact?
text: Hack4Impact is another hackathon by IEEE-CS VIT focusing on solving SDG-based problems.

title: Are there any prerequisites for HackBattle?
text: No strict prerequisites—anyone with enthusiasm can join.

title: Does HackBattle provide networking opportunities?
text: Yes, participants get to connect with peers, mentors, and industry experts.

title: Is HackBattle competitive?
text: Yes, it is a highly competitive hackathon with industry-level judging.

title: Is HackBattle collaborative?
text: Yes, collaboration among team members is a core part of the experience.

title: How many hackathons has IEEE-CS VIT organized?
text: IEEE-CS VIT has organized multiple hackathons, including HackBattle under ARCS.

title: Does HackBattle provide certificates?
text: Yes, participants and winners receive certificates of participation.

title: What benefits do participants get from HackBattle?
text: Learning, collaboration, problem-solving experience, prizes, and recognition.
